decisions.decision: Choose the provenance-required invariant compatible with bounded historical relays
decisions.rationale: Normal new, old init --infer and plain first specify writes begin history at specify. Cross-source first writes may prepend exactly one brainstorm or quick work/review seed before specify. For feature histories shorter than the existing 20-entry retention bound, a missing such normal start requires exactly one valid attached decision; phase none always requires it. Full 20-entry histories may be truncated and retain legacy compatibility. Presence of attached or attach-approved always requires valid attached provenance even at the bound. This cannot prove origin after an attacker consistently replaces/removes all plaintext evidence or fabricates a saturated history; git/PR review remains authoritative. Fourteen synthetic feature-phase fixtures previously recorded only their terminal phase; they now include a normal specify start so their named positive/negative semantics remain independently tested. The real completed specs/001-baton-template baton is untouched and validates. No scope expansion or normal phase producer behavior is changed.
